description: Lists the Proxmox VE server profiles configured in PMXSpan and shows which one is connected. Other tools answer only for the connected server.
name: list_servers
title: List servers

description: Lists the cluster's nodes with status, CPU, memory, uptime and whether PMXSpan has them in maintenance.

server.description: PMXSpan server profile id or name. Default: the server PMXSpan is connected to.

name: list_nodes
title: List nodes

description: Lists VMs and containers with VMID, name, kind, node, status, pool, tags and main IP addresses (from PMXSpan's IPAM and, when recently seen, the guest agent). All filters are optional and combine.

pool.description: Only guests in this resource pool.

server.description: PMXSpan server profile id or name. Default: the server PMXSpan is connected to.

status.description: Only guests in this state, e.g. running, stopped, paused.

name: list_guests
title: List guests

description: Shows one guest: status, CPU/memory/disk, node, pool, tags, HA state, every known IP address (IPAM, static config, guest agent), snapshot names and a short configuration summary. Secrets are never included.

server.description: PMXSpan server profile id or name. Default: the server PMXSpan is connected to.

name: get_guest
title: Get guest

description: Finds which guest (or node) owns an IP address: checks PMXSpan's IPAM first, then the nodes, static guest network config, and finally the guest agents and container interfaces of running guests. Use it to map an SSH session's host address to a VM or container.

ip.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address, e.g. 10.0.0.15 (a /prefix is ignored).

server.description: PMXSpan server profile id or name. Default: the server PMXSpan is connected to.

name: find_by_ip
title: Find guest by IP

description: Queries PMXSpan's local IP address management: with an address, shows who holds it (or whether it is free and in which pool); without one, lists the pools usable on the server with their used and free counts.

server.description: PMXSpan server profile id or name. Default: the server PMXSpan is connected to.

name: ipam_lookup
title: IPAM lookup

description: Lists recent Proxmox tasks (newest first) with type, target, user, start time, status and UPID. Pass a UPID to get_task_log for its output.

server.description: PMXSpan server profile id or name. Default: the server PMXSpan is connected to.

name: list_tasks
title: List tasks

description: Shows a task's status and the last lines of its log.

server.description: PMXSpan server profile id or name. Default: the server PMXSpan is connected to.

upid.description: Task id (UPID:...), from list_tasks or an action's result.

name: get_task_log
title: Get task log

description: Shows one node's CPU, load, memory, swap, root disk, kernel, Proxmox VE version and uptime.

server.description: PMXSpan server profile id or name. Default: the server PMXSpan is connected to.

name: get_node_status
title: Get node status

description: Lists backups on the cluster's backup storages (newest first), optionally for one guest or one node.

node.description: Only storages seen from this node.

server.description: PMXSpan server profile id or name. Default: the server PMXSpan is connected to.

name: list_backups
title: List backups

description: Lists a guest's snapshots, oldest first, with time, description and whether RAM state is included.

server.description: PMXSpan server profile id or name. Default: the server PMXSpan is connected to.

name: list_snapshots
title: List snapshots

description: Compares PMXSpan's IPAM with the guests' network configuration: addresses kept for deleted guests, static addresses IPAM does not track, main addresses that differ, and PMXSpan-created guests without an IPAM record.

server.description: PMXSpan server profile id or name. Default: the server PMXSpan is connected to.

name: list_ipam_drift
title: List IPAM drift

description: Starts, shuts down, reboots, stops (hard), suspends or resumes a guest. Waits up to 30 seconds for the Proxmox task and returns its UPID and outcome. Shutdown falls back to a hard stop after 3 minutes, like in PMXSpan.

server.description: PMXSpan server profile id or name. Default: the server PMXSpan is connected to.

name: power
title: Power action

description: Takes a snapshot of a guest. Waits up to 30 seconds for the task and returns its UPID and outcome.

name.description: Snapshot name: starts with a letter; letters, digits, '-' and '_'; at most 40 characters.

server.description: PMXSpan server profile id or name. Default: the server PMXSpan is connected to.

vmstate.description: Include the VM's RAM (QEMU only, default false).

name: snapshot_create
title: Create snapshot

description: Runs a command inside a running QEMU VM through the QEMU guest agent (no shell: pass the program and its arguments) and returns the exit code and output (capped at 16 KiB each). Refused when the agent is not running; containers have no guest agent.

server.description: PMXSpan server profile id or name. Default: the server PMXSpan is connected to.

stdin.description: Optional data for the command's standard input.

name: agent_exec
title: Run command via guest agent

description: Replaces a guest's Proxmox tags with the given list (an empty list removes all tags).

server.description: PMXSpan server profile id or name. Default: the server PMXSpan is connected to.

tags.description: Tags: letters, digits, '_', '-', '+' and '.', starting with a letter, digit or '_'.

name: set_tags
title: Set tags
